cards.title: Afreet
cards.text: Afreet can host up to 3 MU of programs. Hosted programs use Afreet's hosting capacity instead of Runner MU.

cards.title: AI Boon
cards.text: 1: Break sentry subroutine. 1: +1 strength. At the start of each run, roll a die to determine AI Boon’s strength for that run.

cards.title: Baedeker’s Net Map
cards.text: 0: Base link 1. 1: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

cards.title: Bakdoor™
cards.text: 0: Base link 3. 2: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

cards.title: Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker
cards.text:
1 credit: Break ice subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.
After passing each piece of ice, roll a die if you used Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker to break any subroutines of that ice. On a 1, trash Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker.

cards.title: Black Dahlia
cards.text:
2 credits: Break sentry subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

cards.title: Blink
cards.text:
0 credits: Roll a die. On a 4, 5, or 6, break ice subroutine; otherwise, suffer that much Net damage.
Use this ability only once on each subroutine during each encounter with a piece of ice.

cards.title: Boardwalk
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Boardwalk counter. At the start of each of your turns, every two Boardwalk counters require the Corp to show you, at random, a card stored in HQ. If the Corp does not have enough cards stored in HQ, the Corp shows you as many cards as it has. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

cards.title: Butcher Boy
cards.text: When installed, place 1 Virus counter on this program. 1 recurring credit for run costs. The Corp may purge Virus counters.

cards.title: Cascade
cards.text: When installed, place 1 Virus counter on this program. 1 recurring credit for run costs. The Corp may purge Virus counters.

cards.title: Cloak
cards.text: Put 3 credits on Cloak when it is installed. Use these credits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for noisy icebreakers. If you use any credits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: Clown
cards.text: All ice is encountered with its strength reduced by 1.

cards.title: Cockroach
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Cockroach counter. Two or more Cockroach counters cause all discards from HQ to become random. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

cards.title: Codecracker
cards.text:
0 credits: Break code gate subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

cards.title: Codeslinger
cards.text: 0 credits: Break sentry subroutine.

cards.title: Cyfermaster™
cards.text:
2 credits: Break code gate subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

cards.title: Deep Thought
cards.text: When installed, place 1 Virus counter on this program. 1 recurring credit for run costs. The Corp may purge Virus counters.

cards.title: Dogcatcher
cards.text:
1 credit: Break ice subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

cards.title: Dropp™
cards.text:
1 credit: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

cards.title: Dupré
cards.text: 1: Break code gate subroutine. 2: +1 strength. Put a +1 strength counter on Dupré after each run during which it was used to break a subroutine. All strength counters on Dupré are lost if you use Dupré on a fort other than the one you last used it on.

cards.title: Dwarf
cards.text:
1 credit: Break wall subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

cards.title: Emergency Self-Construct
cards.text: T: Prevent yourself from being flatlined, though you still lose all cards in your hand. Remove all brain damage. For the remainder of the game, you have only three actions per turn, instead of four; your hand size is reduced by 1; and all meat damage is automatically prevented.

cards.title: Evil Twin
cards.text:
3 credits: Break sentry subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.
Prevents up to 2 net and/or core damage total each turn.

cards.title: Expert Schedule Analyzer
cards.text: After you access cards from HQ, look at all cards stored in HQ.

cards.title: Fait Accompli
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run on a subsidiary data fort, put a Fait counter in that fort. Every two Fait counters in a fort give +1 difficulty to all agendas installed inside that fort. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

cards.title: False Echo
cards.text: [2]: The Corp must rez as much ice as possible on a fort, beginning with the outermost ice and working in. Use this ability only after a successful run on that fort.

cards.title: Flak
cards.text: [1]: Break AP subroutine. [1]: +1 strength.

cards.title: Force Shield
cards.text: Prevents up to 2 net and/or core damage total each turn.

cards.title: Gremlins
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Gremlin counter. Every two Gremlin counters decrease the Corp’s hand size by 1. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

cards.title: Grubb
cards.text:
1 credit: Break wall subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength for the remainder of this run.

cards.title: Hammer
cards.text: [1]: Break wall subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Hammer, lose a total of [2] from stealth cards.

cards.title: I Spy
cards.text: Installed helper: reveal the top card of the Runner stack through a side-safe reveal action.

cards.title: Imp
cards.text: Imp can have up to 2 MU of programs installed in it. All icebreakers installed in this way have their strength reduced by 1. If IMP leaves play, trash all programs installed in it.

cards.title: Incubator
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run, give the Corp an Incubate counter. Each Incubate counter necessitates a die roll at the start of each of your turns; on each 6, choose a Virus counter and exchange that counter for two counters of the same type. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

cards.title: Invisibility
cards.text: Put 1 from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: Jackhammer
cards.text:
0 credits: Break wall subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

cards.title: Japanese Water Torture
cards.text:
0: Break wall subroutine.
X: +X strength, and forgo your next X actions.

cards.title: Joan of Arc
cards.text: Installed prevention tool: once each turn, prevent 1 net or core damage.

cards.title: Krash
cards.text:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

cards.title: Loony Goon
cards.text:
1 credit: Break sentry subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

cards.title: Microtech AI Interface
cards.text: Whenever you are about to access cards from R&D, you may first choose to cut any number of cards from the top of R&D to the bottom of R&D.

cards.title: Mouse
cards.text: A: Expose a card installed inside a data fort.

cards.title: Mystery Box
cards.text: 0: Show the top five cards of your stack to the Corp. If any of those cards are programs, trash Mystery Box and then install one of those programs, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. Use this ability only during a run and only once each run.

cards.title: Netspace Inverter
cards.text: Reverse a fort’s ice cards so that the outermost piece of ice becomes the innermost piece of ice, and so forth. Use this ability only immediately after a successful run on that data fort.

cards.title: Newsgroup Filter
cards.text: A: Gain [2].

cards.title: Pattel’s Virus
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run, put a Pattel counter on a piece of ice that had all its subroutines broken during that run. Each Pattel counter on a piece of ice reduces its strength by 1. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

cards.title: Pile Driver
cards.text: 3: Break up to four wall subroutines on a single piece of ice. 1: +1 strength. Whenever you use Pile Driver’s break-walls subroutine, lose a total of 3 from stealth cards.

cards.title: Poltergeist
cards.text: Put [2] on Poltergeist when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for trashing nodes. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: Pox
cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run, put a Pox counter in the fort that was run. Every two Pox counters in a fort require the Corp to pay 1, in addition to any other costs, to install a card inside or on that fort. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

cards.title: R&D-Protocol Files
cards.text: Provides +1 MU. Put 9 from the bank on Microcyb Owl when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. You may place only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

cards.title: Rabbit
cards.text: Ice that attempts to trace you has its trace limit reduced by 1.

cards.title: Raffles
cards.text:
0 credits: Break code gate subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

cards.title: Ramming Piston
cards.text: Ice that attempts to trace you has its trace limit reduced by 1.

cards.title: Raptor
cards.text:
2 credits: Break sentry subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

cards.title: Reflector
cards.text: (0): Break stun, hellbolt, or knockout subroutine.

cards.title: Replicator
cards.text: 0: Break ice subroutine that traces. 1: +1 strength.

cards.title: Scatter Shot
cards.text: Put [2] from the bank on Scatter Shot when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for trashing upgrades. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: SeeYa
cards.text: A, 1: Expose an installed card.

cards.title: Self-Modifying Code
cards.text: T: Search your stack for a program and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. Use this ability only during a run.

cards.title: Shaka
cards.text:
1 credit: Break sentry subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

cards.title: Shield
cards.text: Prevents up to 2 Net damage each turn.

cards.title: Shredder Uplink Protocol
cards.text: A: Make a run on the Archives. If run is successful, do not access cards from the Archives; instead, treat run as a successful run on HQ.

cards.title: Signpost
cards.text: 1: +2 link. Use this ability only once during each trace attempt, and only after you and the Corp have revealed how much each of you spent.

cards.title: Skivviss
cards.text: When installed, place 1 Virus counter on this program. 1 recurring credit for run costs. The Corp may purge Virus counters.

cards.title: Smarteye
cards.text: Once during each run, you may expose a piece of unrezzed ice as you approach it. You may then jack out before the Corp decides whether to rez the ice.

cards.title: Snowball
cards.text:
1 credit: Break sentry subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

cards.title: Speed Trap
cards.text: 0: Jack out before an upgrade or node takes effect. Use this ability only immediately after the Corp has rezzed that upgrade or node.

cards.title: Startup Immolator
cards.text: T: Pay the rez cost of a piece of ice to trash that piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

cards.title: Succubus
cards.text: Succubus can host up to 3 MU of programs. If Succubus leaves play, trash all hosted programs.

cards.title: Tinweasel
cards.text: 0 credits: Break code gate subroutine.

cards.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
cards.text: Put 2 from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: Wild Card
cards.text:
0 credits: Break sentry subroutine.
3 credits: +1 strength.

cards.title: Wizard’s Book
cards.text:
0 credits: Break code gate subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

cards.title: Worm
cards.text:
0 credits: Break wall subroutine.
3 credits: +1 strength.

cards.title: Zetatech Software Installer
cards.text: Put 2 bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overlying Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: All-Nighter
cards.text: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

cards.title: Anonymous Tip
cards.text: Derez a piece of black ice of your choice.

cards.title: Arasaka Owns You
cards.text: Do not play Arasaka Owns You as a normal action; instead, play it when you would suffer enough damage to flatline you. Prevent all of that damage, trash Arasaka Owns You, remove any brain damage you have suffered, and then refresh your hand to its maximum size. Gain 10 and remove all tags, at no cost. You forgo your next four actions, and you forfeit the next 3 agenda points you score.

cards.title: Bodyweight™ Synthetic Blood
cards.text: Draw five cards.

cards.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
cards.text: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

cards.title: Custodial Position
cards.text: Make a run on R&D. If successful, access two additional cards from R&D.

cards.title: Deal with Militech
cards.text: Play only if the Runner liberated a Research agenda this turn. Put a Militech counter on each installed icebreaker.

cards.title: Desperate Competitor
cards.text: Play only if you liberated any Gray Ops agendas this turn. Score 1 agenda point.

cards.title: Edited Shipping Manifests
cards.text: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses 1, Runner gains 1 tag and the Corp draws 1 card.

cards.title: Executive Wiretaps
cards.text: Make a run on HQ. If successful, access two additional cards from HQ.

cards.title: Forged Activation Orders
cards.text: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

cards.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
cards.text: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

cards.title: Fortress Respecification
cards.text: Play only if you made a successful run this turn. Rearrange the ice installed on the last fort on which you made a successful run. This does not expose any concealed ice.

cards.title: Gideon’s Pawnshop
cards.text: Search your trash for a card and bring it into your hand.

cards.title: Hot Tip for WNS
cards.text: Score 1 agenda point if you liberated any Black Ops agendas this turn.

cards.title: Hunt Club BBS
cards.text: Expose up to three installed Corp cards through a side-safe target choice.

cards.title: Ice and Data’s Guide to the Net
cards.text: Expose the outermost ice of each data fort.

cards.title: If You Want It Done Right...
cards.text: Look through the top five cards of your stack. Bring one of those cards into your hand, and arrange the rest in any order you choose.

cards.title: Inside Job
cards.text: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

cards.title: Jack ’n’ Joe
cards.text: Draw three cards.

cards.title: Kilroy Was Here
cards.text: Make a run on R&D; you may trash, at no cost, any cards you access that were stored in R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed.

cards.title: Livewire’s Contacts
cards.text: Gain 3.

cards.title: Lucidrine™ Booster Drug
cards.text: Make a run, and gain [9], which you may use only during that run. After that run is completed, suffer 1 brain damage; this damage cannot be prevented. Then, return to the bank any of the [9] not spent.

cards.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
cards.text: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

cards.title: misc.for-sale
cards.text: Trash any number of your installed cards. Gain [3] for each card trashed in this way.

cards.title: MIT West Tier
cards.text: Shuffle your grip, heap and stack together, draw five cards, then remove MIT West Tier from the game.

cards.title: Open-Ended® Mileage Program
cards.text: Remove a tag, at no cost. You may pay 1 when you play Open-Ended® Mileage Program to take it back into your hand instead of trashing it.

cards.title: Organ Donor
cards.text: Trash up to five cards from your hand. Gain [2] for each card trashed in this way.

cards.title: Playful AI
cards.text: Roll a die. On a 1, 2, or 3, gain that many bits, set aside that many dice to roll again, or choose some combination thereof. Repeat until you have rolled all the dice you set aside.

cards.title: Priority Wreck
cards.text: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

cards.title: Private LDL Access
cards.text: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, treat it as a successful run on R&D instead of accessing HQ.

cards.title: Romp through HQ
cards.text: Make a run on HQ; you may trash, at no cost, any cards you access that were stored in HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed.

cards.title: Score!
cards.text: Gain 9.

cards.title: Security Code WORM Chip
cards.text: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

cards.title: Sneak Preview
cards.text: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

cards.title: Social Engineering
cards.text: Hide at least 2 from your pool in your hand; the Corp then guesses how many bits you hid. If the Corp guesses correctly, lose that many bits. Otherwise, choose a data fort and a piece of ice on that fort. Then make a run on that fort, during which you automatically pass that piece of ice.

cards.title: Stumble through Wilderspace
cards.text: Make a run. You have +9 link for every trace attempt made during that run.

cards.title: Synchronized Attack on HQ
cards.text: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. The Corp discards all cards. The Corp can retain cards by paying [2] for each card not discarded.

cards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
cards.text: Search your stack for a program, reveal it and bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

cards.title: Terrorist Reprisal
cards.text: Play only if the Corp scored any Black Ops agendas during its last turn. The Corp discards five cards at random.

cards.title: Total Genetic Retrofit
cards.text: Remove all tags, at no cost, and automatically avoid receiving your next tag.

cards.title: Valu-Pak Software Bundle
cards.text: Gain up to five consecutive actions, which you may use only to install programs, and gain [1]. If you do not spend the bit during these actions, return it to the bank afterwards.

cards.title: Weather-to-Finance Pipe
cards.text: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses 4 credits.

cards.title: Arasaka Portable Prototype
cards.text: Provides +3 MU. Installing Arasaka Portable Prototype costs 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. Put [3] from the bank on Arasaka Portable Prototype when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

cards.title: “Armadillo” Armored Road Home
cards.text: Put [2] from the bank on Armored Road Home when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for removing tags. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. [T]: Prevent up to 3 meat damage.

cards.title: Armored Fridge
cards.text: Installed prevention tool: once each turn, prevent 2 meat damage.

cards.title: Artemis 2020
cards.text: Provides +2 MU. Put [2] from the bank on Artemis 2020 when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

cards.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
cards.text: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

cards.title: Corolla Speed Chip
cards.text: Put [1] from the bank on Corolla Speed Chip when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using killers during runs. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: Dermatech Bodyplating
cards.text: Prevents 1 meat damage each turn.

cards.title: “Drifter” Mobile Environment
cards.text: Put [2] from the bank on Mobile Environment when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for removing tags. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: Full Body Conversion
cards.text: Prevents all meat damage. For each 1 credit the Corp pays when meat damage is done, 1 meat damage is not prevented.

cards.title: “Green Knight” Surge Buffers
cards.text: Installed prevention tool: once each turn, prevent 2 net damage.

cards.title: HQ Interface
cards.text: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

cards.title: Lifesaver™ Nanosurgeons
cards.text: Installed prevention tool: once each turn, prevent 1 core damage.

cards.title: Microtech Backup Drive
cards.text:
Whenever one or more installed programs are being sent to the trash at the same time, you may instead choose to put any or all of the programs on top of Microtech Backup Drive in any order you choose. If Backup Drive is removed from play, trash any cards on it.
A: Bring the top card on Backup Drive into your hand.

cards.title: Microtech ’Trode Set
cards.text: Pay [1], in addition to the normal cost, to break each ice subroutine. Ignore all AP subroutines except those that trace, or that do Net damage. Prevents all but 1 Net damage from each AP subroutine you do not break.

cards.title: Militech MRAM Chip
cards.text: Hand size +3.

cards.title: MRAM Chip
cards.text: Hand size +2.

cards.title: Nasuko Cycle
cards.text: Installed prevention tool: once each turn, prevent 1 net or meat damage.

cards.title: Pandora’s Deck
cards.text: Provides +2 MU. Put [3] from the bank on Pandora’s Deck when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for increasing your link. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

cards.title: Parraline 5750
cards.text: Provides +1 MU. Put [1] from the bank on Parraline 5750 when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

cards.title: PK-6089a
cards.text: Provides +1 MU. Put [3] from the bank on PK-6089a when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for increasing your link. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

cards.title: R&D Interface
cards.text: Installed access tool: access 1 additional card whenever you access R&D.

cards.title: Raven Microcyb Eagle
cards.text: Provides +1 MU. Prevents 1 Net damage each turn. Put [1] from the bank on Microcyb Eagle when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

cards.title: Raven Microcyb Owl
cards.text: Provides +1 MU. Put 3 from the bank on Microcyb Owl when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

cards.title: Record Reconstructor
cards.text: A: Make a run on the Archives. If run is successful, do not access cards from the Archives; instead, shuffle the face-up pile of the Archives and then put the top two cards from that pile on R&D.

cards.title: Techtronica™ Utility Suit
cards.text: Installed prevention tool: once each turn, prevent 1 meat or net damage.

cards.title: Tycho Mem Chip
cards.text: Provides +3 MU.

cards.title: WuTech Mem Chip
cards.text: Provides +1 MU.

cards.title: Zetatech Mem Chip
cards.text: Provides +2 MU.

cards.title: ZZ22 Speed Chip
cards.text: Put [2] from the bank on ZZ22 Speed Chip when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using killers during runs. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: Access through Alpha
cards.text: [1]: Base link 9. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

cards.title: Access to Arasaka
cards.text: [2]: Base link 4. [2]: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

cards.title: Access to Kiribati
cards.text: [1]: Base link 1. [1]: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

cards.title: Aujourd’Oui
cards.text: A: Look at the top five cards of your stack. You may bring any program cards among them into your hand. Pay [1] for each card taken in this way, and show those cards to the Corp. Shuffle your stack.

cards.title: Back Door to Hilliard
cards.text: [0]: Base link 2. [3]: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

cards.title: Back Door to Orbital Air
cards.text: [1]: Base link 2. [2]: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

cards.title: Broker
cards.text: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

cards.title: Code Viral Cache
cards.text: Play only after a successful HQ run this turn. When the Corp purges Virus counters, choose up to two counters that are not removed. The Corp may take an action and pay 5 to trash Code Viral Cache.

cards.title: Corporate Ally
cards.text: Installing Corporate Ally costs 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. The difficulty of all agendas is +1.

cards.title: Crash Everett, Inventive Fixer
cards.text: Whenever you draw one or more cards from your stack, draw an extra card; then choose one of the cards drawn and either trash it or return it to the top of your stack. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

cards.title: Danshi’s Second ID
cards.text: A, [T]: Remove up to three tags, at no cost.

cards.title: Databroker
cards.text: A, [T], 1 agenda point: Gain 10 credits.

cards.title: Diplomatic Immunity
cards.text: Prevents all meat damage. The Corp may pay 1 agenda point to cancel this effect until end of turn. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

cards.title: Fall Guy
cards.text: Installed prevention tool: once each turn, prevent 1 meat or net damage.

cards.title: Field Reporter for Ice and Data
cards.text: At the end of each of your turns, gain [1] for each piece of ice the Corp rezzed during that turn.

cards.title: Floating Runner BBS
cards.text: Gain 1 credit at the start of each of your turns.

cards.title: Hell's Run
cards.text: Put 1 from the bank on Hell's Run when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for increasing your link. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

cards.title: Junkyard BBS
cards.text: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

cards.title: Karl de Veres, Corporate Stooge
cards.text: Gain [1] each time you make a successful run. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

cards.title: Leland, Corporate Bodyguard
cards.text: [1]: Prevent 1 meat damage. [T]: Avoid receiving a tag.

cards.title: Loan from Chiba

cards.text: When accessed, Runner trashes one installed daemon program.

cards.title: Crybaby
cards.text: When Runner accesses Crybaby, give Runner a Crying counter. Each Crying counter reduces Runner's link by 2 during each trace attempt. Runner can remove a Crying counter by taking an action to pay [2].

cards.title: Crystal Palace Station Grid
cards.text:
Runner must pay 1, in addition to the normal cost, to break each subroutine of each piece of ice encountered during runs on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

cards.title: Dedicated Response Team
cards.text: When Runner accesses Dedicated Response Team, it does 3 meat damage. Ignore this effect unless Runner is tagged.

cards.title: Dieter Esslin
cards.text: When Runner accesses Dieter Esslin, Dieter does 1 Net damage.

cards.title: Dr. Dreff
cards.text: Whenever Runner makes a successful run on this fort, you may choose an ice card stored in HQ. Pay half of that card's rez cost, rounded down, to force Runner to encounter it; the run is not considered successful unless Runner passes that piece of ice. Trash that ice after the encounter ends. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

cards.title: Jenny Jett
cards.text: Whenever Runner makes a successful run on this fort, you may choose an ice card stored in HQ. Install that piece of ice on this fort in the innermost position, 	paying an installation cost of [1] for each piece of ice already on the fort. Runner is now considered to be approaching that piece of ice. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

cards.title: Jerusalem City Grid
cards.text: Cost to rez walls on this fort is reduced by [2]. All walls on this fort have +1 strength. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

cards.title: Namatoki Plaza
cards.text: Rez Namatoki Plaza when you install it. Install Namatoki Plaza only if you can pay to rez it. Install only inside a subsidiary data fort. That fort may have an additional agenda or node installed inside it. If Namatoki Plaza leaves play while installed, and this results in the fort having too many agendas and nodes installed inside it, trash one of those agendas or nodes.

cards.title: New Galveston City Grid
cards.text:
All nodes and other upgrades installed inside this fort cost 2 to trash, in addition to the normal cost.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

cards.title: Olivia Salazar
cards.text: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

cards.title: Omni Kismet, Ph.D.
cards.text: Swap a piece of unrezzed ice on this fort with an ice card stored in HQ. The new ice card comes into play concealed. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

cards.title: Paris City Grid
cards.text: Put [3] from the bank on Paris City Grid when you rez it. Use these bits only to pay for traces made during runs on this fort. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

cards.title: Red Herrings
cards.text: Runner must pay 5, in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

cards.title: Rio de Janeiro City Grid
cards.text:
Roll a die whenever Runner passes a piece of rezzed ice during a run on this fort. On a 1, end the run.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

cards.title: Roving Submarine
cards.text:
Install only inside a subsidiary data fort. This fort may be run only if you installed or advanced a card inside or on this fort during your last turn.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

cards.title: Singapore City Grid
cards.text:
Swap a piece of unrezzed ice on this fort with an ice card stored in HQ. The new ice card comes into play concealed. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

cards.title: Tesseract Fort Construction
cards.text: All ice on this fort has an additional subroutine, "*End the run unless Runner pays [1]," after all other subroutines.

cards.title: Tokyo-Chiba Infighting
cards.text:
Gain 2 after each unsuccessful run on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort.

cards.title: Turbeau Delacroix
cards.text: Trace 10-If trace is successful, give Runner a tag. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Turbeau Delacroix, and only once during each run on this fort.

cards.title: Twenty-Four-Hour Surveillance
cards.text: During runs on this fort, Runner cannot use bits from stealth sources.

cards.title: Washington, D.C., City Grid
cards.text:
The difficulty of agendas installed inside this fort is reduced by 1.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.
